description: Fixed 1600-episode selected subset of RxR-CE guide-English val_unseen for the navigation task, with original episode IDs and matching Landmark-RxR annotations.

fingerprint.episode_sha256: Original episode with only instruction.timed_instruction omitted; all other fields preserved. Native word timestamps are not part of this Landmark dataset.
fingerprint.gt_sha256: Complete original official GT record for the episode ID.
fingerprint.landmark_sha256: Complete original matched Landmark-RxR row without edits.
fingerprint.ordering: Fixed manifest order. source_index is the original English-filtered index; source_record_index is the original index in the full guide file. Reordered inputs are matched by episode ID.

quality_filter.matching: Unique instruction_id, matching scene, trajectory_id and normalized full instruction.
quality_filter.text_normalization: Compare re.findall('[a-z0-9]+', text.lower()); case and punctuation are ignored, spelling and word sequence changes are excluded.
quality_filter.segmentation: Concatenated nonempty sub-instructions must preserve the normalized full instruction exactly.
quality_filter.path_alignment: Equal CE/Landmark path lengths; unique path nodes; sub_paths are ordered contiguous slices covering every path edge exactly once.

reviewed_boundary_exclusions.1436: The boundary after 'till you see' separates the movement condition from 'right side steps'.
reviewed_boundary_exclusions.8525: Boundaries split 'in front of / you' and 'you pass / through that glass door'.
